about_the_game:
A new AI weapon of mass destruction could mean the end of the world as we know it. You’ll need everything at your disposal to take on this machine of war. Take power back with the War Machine Accelerated Event Pass*.

Get access to:
  • 30 tiers of unlockable content
  • 15 Tier Skips
  • The Legendary "CENTRAL Unit India" outfit for Angel
Secure the top-tier content of the Event Pass – and save humanity from total domination.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560,Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No recommendation
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, Intel Core i7 4790
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT, Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No recommendation
